## Checklist

- [ ] I starred this repository (required to get listed).
- [ ] The link opens without signing in.
- [ ] Public Pages use mock or public data, never personal info.
- [ ] The Page contains no private data (personal emails, names of private people, account IDs, inbox items, file paths).
- [ ] The Page follows the Grok Bot Pages content rules.
- [ ] The Page has real data or a working control, and no placeholder text.
- [ ] The entry credits a name plus a GitHub handle, an X handle, or both.
- [ ] The entry includes the prompt in a `<details>` block, and the prompt contains no private details.
- [ ] The entry follows the format: `- [Title](public page link) - One factual sentence. By Name ([@github](https://github.com/handle), [@x](https://x.com/handle)).` followed by the `Template page:` line and the `<details><summary>Prompt</summary>` block (see README, Entry format).
- [ ] If this is the first entry in its section, I removed the "No Pages yet" line.
- [ ] Optional, strongly requested: the Page ends with the "Made with Grok Bot" footer linking to this list.
